title: Community Guidelines
subtitle: Principles of conduct that maintain a professional, respectful, and safe environment for all Cricbet99 players.
intro: Cricbet99 is more than just a betting platform; it's a community of elite Indian sports fans. To maintain a premier experience, we expect all members to follow these simple rules of conduct.
We prioritize respect, integrity, and fair play. Our guidelines are designed to prevent harassment, fraud, and any activity that could compromise the safety of our players or staff.
Membership at Cricbet99 is a privilege. By following these guidelines, you help us maintain our reputation as India's most trusted and professional cricket ID platform.

features.title: Respectful Communication
features.desc: We maintain a zero-tolerance policy for abusive language toward other members or our 24/7 support team.

features.title: Integrity in Betting
features.desc: We expect members to participate fairly. Any attempt to exploit system errors or syndicate betting is prohibited.

features.title: Privacy of Others
features.desc: Never share another member's details or support logs. We respect your privacy and expect you to do the same.

features.title: Prohibited Content
features.desc: Sharing illegal links, spam, or promotional material within our community channels will result in immediate bans.

features.title: Account Ownership
features.desc: Only use the ID created for you. Sharing accounts or betting on behalf of others is strictly forbidden.

features.title: Constructive Feedback
features.desc: We welcome suggestions for improvement through official channels, but public defamation is against our values.
